exact_query: GET https://arxiv.org/e-print/2202.08289 -> tar.gz -> ICL_on_A370_and_AS1063.tex -> table* env captioned 'ICL fractions and ICL radius measured for A370 and AS1063'
extraction: arXiv source tarball; LaTeX table* environment identified by caption text. Row count asserted ==2.
note: *** PRODUCT 3 (ICL fraction) for ABELL 370 and ABELL S1063 -- the two HFF clusters MISSING from Jimenez-Teja et al. 2018. de Oliveira, Jimenez-Teja et al. 2022 (MNRAS), 'The intracluster light on Frontier Fields clusters Abell 370 and Abell S1063'. BANDS: HST F435W, F606W, F814W (observed frame). ICL/BCG SEPARATION METHOD: CICLE -- same wavelet/CHEF-based algorithm as Jimenez-Teja+2018, so these two rows ARE directly comparable to jimenez_teja2018_icl_fractions_cicle.tsv and together the two files give a homogeneous CICLE ICL fraction for all six HFF clusters. No SB threshold, no radius cut, no parametric assumption about the BCG or ICL shape. RADIAL RANGE: per-filter, in the R_*_kpc columns (114.2-331.1 kpc); ICL integrated to the radius where the ICL flux profile is minimum. Note the strong band-to-band spread (A370: 7.1% in F435W vs 25.1% in F606W) -- the F435W ICL radius is roughly a third of the F606W one, so the band difference is largely an aperture difference, not a colour effect. MASS-MODEL DEPENDENCE: none for the tabulated fractions. (The paper additionally plots f_ICL vs R_200 using R_200 = 2.57 Mpc for A370 from Lah+2009 and 2.7 Mpc for AS1063 from Sartoris+2020 -- those R_200 values are dynamical and are NOT part of this table.) Errors combine photometric error, cluster-membership (spectroscopic completeness) error, and the empirical CICLE BCG/ICL separation error from 10 mock-image realizations per filter.
